---
title: "QUILT2 long-format table"
format: html
params:
  data_file: "quilt2_parameter_extract.parquet"
---

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyr)

# Read only the identifiers, existing accuracy metrics, and parameters needed.
parameter_columns <- c("mean_info_score", "info__hwe")
wide_table <- read_parquet(
  params$data_file,
  col_select = all_of(c(
    "locus_id", "chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "run_id", "treatment", "panel",
    "sample_id", "truth_source", "array_group", "gt_correct",
    "percent_correct_panel", "percent_correct_pooled", parameter_columns
  ))
)

long_table <- pivot_longer(
  wide_table,
  cols = all_of(parameter_columns),
  names_to = "parameter",
  values_to = "value"
)

# Preview only; long_table contains all loaded rows, including missing values.
head(long_table, 20)
```

`long_table` has one row per locus × treatment × panel × sample × parameter.
Nothing is recalculated. For INFO_SCORE use `percent_correct_pooled`; for HWE
use `percent_correct_panel`. Site-level values repeat across samples, so these
rows are not independent locus observations. GP is not analysed.
